<function name="GetFraction" parent="DNumberScratch" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns the value of the <page>DNumberScratch</page> as a fraction, a value between 0 and 1 where 0 is the minimum and 1 is the maximum value of the <page>DNumberScratch</page>.

See also:
* <page>DNumberScratch:GetTextValue</page>
* <page>DNumberScratch:GetFloatValue</page>
* <page>DNumberScratch:SetFraction</page>
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">A value between 0 and 1</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
